verifies.G064-C2: with the DTO Declaration settings dtoNameRegexp ((?<entity>.*)View) and dtoCommentLinkRegexp ({@link (?<entity>[\w.]+)}) a DTO linked to the entity by its class name (GadgetView) or by its Javadoc (GadgetCard) is offered as the existing class in the DTO creation flow even though its fields differ from the entity; the offer ends the flow with an Already exists message naming the linked type. The empty (disabled) state is RS-542. The original resolves links through an index (Structure view, gutter); only the reuse offer is checked here.
